Name: Tool Icon Replacement
Author: HacePloder
Description:
[b]Updated for v1.1[/b]

I didn't like the look of some of the tools in the Selection Bar, so I changed them to their Harvest Moon (SNES) [url=http://www.spriters-resource.com/snes/harvestmoon/sheet/69093/]counterparts[/url].
I had a lot of trouble quickly deciding what tool to use for what task, mainly because it was hard for me to differentiate the images from what I was used to.
I figured I'd go and change the images myself so I can save seconds on selecting the right tool for the job.


[b]Version 1[/b]: Changes the look of the Hoe and the Axe in the Selection Bar.
[i]The animations when actually swinging these tools are unchanged.
[/i]
[b]Version 1.5[/b]: Only the axe is changed.
[i]This was requested by user "greyassassin24"[/i]

[b]Version 2[/b]: Gives the starter tools a palette swap.
[i]This is exactly the same as Version 1, except the tools your start with are colored differently.[/i]

[b]Version 3[/b]: The Pickaxe is now a Hammer in the Selection Bar.
[i]The animation of swinging a Pickaxe still shows a Pickaxe.
I never played Minecraft, so I associate breaking rocks with Hammers instead of Pickaxes.[/i]


INSTALLATION
Just unzip and drop the file in \Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\TileSheets
You might want to keep a copy of the original file incase you want to revert.
